title: Column Management — Add / Rename / Delete / Reorder
description: Add columns to the active board, rename them, delete them (subject to the non-empty rule), and reorder them, updating board.columnOrder.
spec:
1. Add a new named column; verify it appends to board.columnOrder and renders as a lane
2. Rename a column; verify the header updates and persists
3. Reorder columns; verify board.columnOrder updates and the lane order changes
4. Delete a column per the defined non-empty rule (see column-delete-nonempty-rule)
5. Verify column changes persist across reload
